clustering.label: V-measure
clustering.note: AMI reported alongside in the result JSON; the layer analyses use AMI

label_correction: Earlier exports labelled retrieval and reranking as nDCG@10. The metrics were always hit_rate_at_5 and map_at_5; only the labels were wrong. No score changed.

reranking_candidate_structure.detail: The evaluator builds one corpus from all rows and scores every query against it. Same-speaker hard negatives exist in the dataset construction but impose no per-query pool boundary.

aggregation.capability_balanced: mean rank within capability, then equal weight across speaker and content; channel excluded
aggregation.core_policy: 11 core (8 speaker + 3 content), 3 diagnostic (channel). Demotion is on LABEL PROVENANCE, not on the MFCC comparison.

precision: all tables written with %.17g; no manuscript rounding
